---
title: "Convergence diagnostics"
format: html
---

`convergence = "auto"` retains core-only behavior, `"none"` disables formal
capture, `"core"` requests the five trait variance quantities, and
`"extended"` adds applicable covariance, probability, `selection_s`, and
annotation quantities.

Selected-marker diagnostics require explicit IDs or one-based indices and may
capture effective `b`, binary `d`, and mixture component states where defined.
There is no all-marker shortcut. Trace memory is guarded before sampling.

Diagnostics use rank-normalized split/folded R-hat, bulk/tail/mean ESS, and
MCSE of the posterior mean. They assess chain mixing; passing thresholds does
not prove model correctness or absolute convergence.
